title: Game server list
summary: Servers available to the client after authentication.
description:
# ServerList

## Purpose

The Login Server returns available game servers. Entries provide information needed to select a server and continue connecting.

## Format characteristics

- The message contains repeated entries.
- Some fields may depend on the preceding request type.
- The Login revision and opcode alone do not describe the entire response context.

See {{link scenario:server-selection}}.
